resale_co.name: Construction Records Clearance Certificate (CRCC)
resale_co.lead_time: Apply at least 10 days before the change of ownership; filing less than 10 days before the certificate is needed costs the expedited fee.
resale_co.valid_for: 90 days, and only for permits issued before the CRCC application
requirements: Records check (not a physical inspection) for open construction permits
If permits are open, all final inspections and approvals must be done and certificates issued before the CRCC; the applicant must close all permits and notify the office
Application must list the closing date
Exempt if there is no change in physical occupancy for deed corrections, transfers between spouses, new construction needing a CO, estate distributions, refinancing and similar transfers

fees.label: CRCC, request more than 10 calendar days before closing
fees.quote: [ ] $75.00 Requests received more than 10 calendar days from change of occupancy/closing.

fees.label: CRCC, expedited, request within 10 calendar days of closing
fees.quote: [ ] $150.00 Expedited requests received within 10 calendar days from change of occupancy/closing.

fees.label: CRCC application fee (Township code)
fees.quote: The application fee for the CRCC shall be $75.

fees.label: CRCC expedited review (Township code)
fees.quote: If an application is filed less than 10 days before the CRCC is needed by the applicant, the fee for the expedited review shall be $150.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Construction Records Clearance Certificate application (Township Forms & Permits page) and submit it with the fee to the Construction Office, 46 Mountain Boulevard, Warren (temporary in-person location: Municipal Complex, 3 Mountainview Road). Questions: 908-753-8000 ext. 240, 241 or 242.

evidence.quote: A CRCC shall be required prior to the sale of any residential or commercial structure.
The owner or his authorized agent shall submit a written application and payment of fees at least 10 days' prior to the change of ownership on the form available in the Construction Code Office.

The CRCC shall only be valid for a period of 90 days and shall only apply to any permits issued prior to the CRCC application and shall not apply to any permit applications submitted after the CRCC application.
If open permits are found, applicant MUST close all permits & notify our office to obtain issuance of CRCC.
Application for Construction Records Clearance Certificate

resale_co.notes: Township Code Section 8-13 (added May 9, 2024 by Ord. No. 24-09), read on ecode360, requires a Construction Records Clearance Certificate before the sale of any residential structure. It is a records check for open permits, not a physical inspection or resale CO. The code says the expedite fee applies to filings less than 10 days before the certificate is needed; the application (revised 05/22/2024) says within 10 calendar days of closing. Owners and buyers are jointly responsible. The Township also has a Commercial Property Transfer Certificate for commercial property. Lead-safe certification in Section 8-12 applies to rentals only.

requirements: Smoke detectors on every level (basement, first and second floors) and in every separate sleeping area; basement detector at the bottom of the basement stairs; detectors over 10 years old must be replaced
Battery-only smoke and CO units must be 10-year sealed battery models
Carbon monoxide alarms (UL 2034) within 10 feet of bedroom doors; CO alarms over 7 years old must be replaced unless the manufacturer says otherwise
Portable fire extinguisher (2A:10B:C, no more than 10 lbs) mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen, less than one year old or tagged within one year (Township form and code still list it)

authorities.name: Warren Township Fire Prevention Bureau (Fire Marshal's Office, Warren Township Fire Department)
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on when the request is made: more than 10 business days before the change of occupant for the lowest fee (per the application). No specific inspection dates or times are given; the inspector coordinates the inspection. The inspector waits only 10 minutes; a missed inspection forfeits the fee.

fees.label: Smoke/CO/extinguisher certificate, request more than 10 business days before the change of occupant
fees.quote: requests for a CSDCMAPFEC received more than 10 business days prior to the change of occupant: $50.00

fees.label: Request fewer than 10 business days before the change of occupant
fees.quote: requests for a CSDCMAPFEC received fewer than 10 business prior to the change of occupant $80.00

fees.label: Reinspection before the change of occupant
fees.quote: requests for a CSDCMAPFEC for re-inspection prior to the change of occupant $35.00

authorities.how_to_apply: Print the Application for Certificate of Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide and Portable Fire Extinguisher Compliance, then email it to Fire Secretary Meagan Rivenbark (mrivenbark@warrennj.org) or mail or drop it off at Town Hall. Pay by credit card through MuniciPay (smoke detector applications only), or by cash or check payable to Warren Township.
authorities.contact_title: Fire Secretary (Fire Marshal: Al Shjarback, ext. 259, ashjarback@warrennj.org)

fire_cert.notes: The application (dated September 2026) cites Township Ordinance 2-4.18 and sets $50.00 (more than 10 business days before the change of occupant), $80.00 (fewer than 10 business days) and $35.00 for a reinspection. The code text of Section 2-4.18 on ecode360 uses a different cutoff: $50 if ordered at least five days before the requested inspection, $80 if four days or less, $35 reinspection. Confirm which cutoff the Bureau uses. Both the form and the code still require a portable fire extinguisher, which state law (P.L.2025, c.19) dropped from the sale certificate in February 2025. Township Code Section 10-8.2 says the local fire agency does not enforce the fire code in owner-occupied one and two family homes, but the resale smoke/CO/extinguisher certificate is still issued by the Township under Section 2-4.18.

other_items.label: Open construction permits
other_items.detail: All open construction permits must be closed before the Construction Records Clearance Certificate is issued.

open_questions: Does the Fire Prevention Bureau still require a portable fire extinguisher at resale after P.L.2025, c.19?
Which fee cutoff applies for the smoke/CO certificate: 10 business days before the change of occupant (application) or 5 days before the inspection (code)?
Is the CRCC expedite cutoff counted in calendar days before closing (application) or days before the certificate is needed (code)?
